title: Remote phone panel
responsibility: Guides pairing from a phone and displays connection status and granted access.

inputs.name: RemotePhonePanel.store
inputs.description: Phone status and operations, including scan/disconnect, busy/errors, scan failure and fixture flag. Scan receives the entered device name, initially iPhone.

inputs.name: RemotePhonePanel.compact
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default. Compact hides unpaired setup form/instructions, grant/device details and fixture notice; applicable connection actions and store errors remain.

outputs.name: RemotePhonePanel
outputs.description: Connection panel when status and labels exist. Full unpaired view offers a phone-name input limited to 80 characters and QR scan/retry. Other states display status and a disconnect action labeled Cancel for pairing/pending approval, Connect again for revoked, otherwise Disconnect. Full mode shows grant and phone identity. Busy disables buttons; errors are alerts.
